description: If Ando uses Flash Step while Uncharged, he becomes invulnerable to non-strategic skills for 1 turn.
When Ando uses Focus Power, he gains 5 DR for 2 turns for each target marked by Electroblade.
Expel Energy also marks its target and another random target with Electroblade.
Overclock is now permanent, but Ando receives 15 Affliction damage when he uses a Supercharged ability.
While Ando is Charged or Supercharged, he ignores Counters and Reflects.
Sand Quake's cost is reduced by 1 [65], but Desert Veil only applies Veiled for 1 turn.
If Mirage Trap expires without being triggered, the affected enemy heals the allied Hero directly across from them for 25 HP.
After Desert Veil finishes applying Veiled, the untargeted allied Hero is Veiled for 2 turns.
If Aramao is Veiled, Desert Knife deals 10 more damage and extends the duration of his Veiled effects by 1 turn.
Trial of Sands lasts 1 more turn. While it is active, all enemy Heroes are considered to be across from Aramao, and all allied Heroes are considered to be adjacent to him.
The base damage reduction per ally is increased to 10
Ayana gains 30 shield for 1 turn when she uses Prayer.
If an enemy triggers Voice of Light, it is automatically recast on them, ignoring invulnerability and counters
Prayer makes its target Invulnerable for 1 turn if used on a target below 20 HP.
Prayer and Voice of Light cause 10 more healing or damage, but no longer have a secondary effect.
If the Black Knight defeats an enemy, his skills are enhanced for the following two turns
The turn after activating his passive, The Nightmare Rides costs one less [8].
Oathbreaker Strike deals 15 additional damage to the primary target if Unholy Aura is affecting more than 3 targets
If Dead or Alive successfully redirects an ability, the Black Knight gains Elemental Essence
Oathbreaker Strike deals 10 damage to the target's allies while enhanced.
Dennis will automatically use HS-46 Ascendant Serum on himself any time he receives a stun effect.
Dennis will automatically use HS-112 Fury Serum on himself if an allied Hero dies. If that Hero was Hector the Injector, Dennis uses End of Shift instead.
Pain Tolerance now lasts for 2 turns.
Shared Agony now costs 1 Generic energy, but both parts of its activation now include all allied units.
Big Green Fist deals 5 more base damage, and decreases the remaining cooldown of End of Shift by 1 turn.
If Fate is revived using This Is Not The End, he no longer prevents healing from his allies from affecting him.
Will-o'-wisp no longer gives Fate's team Shield. Instead, the enemy team has their Helpful skills stunned while it is active.
Vulpus Incendia and Vulpus Crystallia can now be used without interrupting Channeling.
Enemies that don't trigger Fox's Cunning during its duration will have their cooldowns paralyzed for 2 turns.
This Is Not The End's trigger limit is now per allied Hero (each Hero can be revived once per round.)
At the start of the game, Gaia creates a Worldsprout minion instead of a Seedling.
Channel Earth heals a random ally for 10 HP
Gaia's minions are created with 10 more maximum HP.
Each time Channel Vitality is triggered, Gaia gains a stack of Channel Earth.
Gaia now starts the round with 3 Seedlings
Galazax can now Channel up to 2 separate copies of The Skies Darken.
Lightning Strikes now deals 10 damage to the primary target and 5 to all other enemies, and becomes Piercing.
The Heavens Speak now costs [65] less and no longer cancels Channeled skills.
Thunder Deafens has its cooldown reduced by 1, but it no longer causes Galazax to ignore damage.
A random enemy Hero starts each round with 3 stacks of The Storm Builds.
Iceblood Hammer and Foot of the Mountain now mark a random enemy on use. The following turn, that enemy will take 20 damage.
While Frost-Covered, Gommar gains 10 points of DR
Breath of the North now lowers the targets damage by 15, lowered by 5 every time they use a skill.
After Gommar consumes Frost-Covered, he regains it at the end of his next turn.
Iceblood Hammer deals 5 less damage and costs one fewer r each time it is used, stacking up to twice.
At the start of each round, Hector automatically casts Burning Blood Serum on Dennis.
Hector's Serum skills cannot be stunned.
Serums now last for 2 additional turns, but their costs are increased by [65].
Dennis the Apprentice begins the game with 20 extra health, and under the effect of a random Serum
Hector may use his Serums on targets other than Dennis once Dennis has died.
Blade of Ashes strikes an additional random enemy for 10 damage. Has no effect if Blade of Ashes is AOE.
Enemies affected by Blackened Wounds ignore healing for 1 turn.
If all enemies affected by Cinderswell are marked by Cinders, they have their non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.
Jarrik splits all single-target damage received between him and any active Cinders.
While Blade of Dancing Lights is active, Cinder minions ignore harmful skills.
If Keeper of Fables still has Shield on Tales to Tell after using Page-turner, the targeted enemy is stunned for 1 turn. Page-turner's cooldown is increased by 1.
If Character Development targets an ally it hasn't targeted yet this round, Keeper of Fables gains Elemental Essence.
If Keeper of Fables is the only living Hero you control, Hero's Return only consumes 50 Shield and costs one less [65].
Shield from Tales to Tell can only take a maximum of 20 damage from a single hit.
If Keeper of Fables doesn't act during his turn, he heals his team for 5 health.
If the target of Nightwrap has 4 Stacks of Deepening Shadows, they become Invulnerable if they are an ally or Stunned if they are an enemy. Effect lasts 1 turn.
If Laria uses Nightwrap on a target without Elemental Essence, she gives them Elemental Essence if they are an ally, and generates a Generic energy if they are an enemy.
Nightwrap now counts stacks of Deepening Shadows on Laria if she is using it on an enemy
Characters with 3 or more stacks of Deepening Shadows Bypass.
When a character receives their 3rd stack of Deepening Shadows, they gain the effects of Vanish.
When Maggie gains Elemental Essence from Bramblelash, she heals 5 health for every stack of Curse of Thorns on her.
Bramblelash, Thornburst, and Grasping Vines deal 5 additional damage if Maggie has 2 or more stacks of Curse of Thorns. This damage increases to 10 when she has 4 or more.
When Maggie's Shield is damaged while Bramblebarrier is active, she deals 5 Piercing damage to the enemy team.
Enemies stunned by Grasping Vines take 15 more damage from Bramblelash.
Targets marked by Bramblelash receive 10 additional damage from Thornburst.
Fan the Flames now costs 1 more [65], but deals 5 additional damage per tick.
Pyrrha heals for 10 health any time Fan the Flames expires or is removed.
Pyrokinesis will now consume Fan the Flames to deal 15 extra damage.
Flashbang now fully stuns the targeted enemy
While Wraith in White is active, Pyrrha deals 5 Affliction damage to the enemy team each turn.
Enemies who have been stunned by Undertow take 10 affliction damage each turn for the rest of the game.
When Soothe expires, it will attempt to jump to an ally that doesn't currently have it.
If River Clone expires without being triggered, it will attempt to jump to an ally that doesn't currently have it.
River Daughter heals 20 health for 2 turns when she uses Dive.
Whenever River Clone is triggered, River Daughter casts Ripple.
Boulder minions are created with 60 HP.
Earth Pillar marks an additional random enemy each time it is used.
Stoneform now lasts 1 additional turn, and while affected by it, Boulders deal double damage when launched with Strength From The Earth.
Boulders are now created with 25 less HP. If Roland destroys a Boulder with Strength From The Earth, he deals 25 Piercing damage to all enemies.
Form Stone now creates two Boulders at a time.
When Saya gives an ally Elemental Essence with Universal Energy Conduit, she also gains Elemental Essence
Saya Coil deals an additional 5 damage for every Saya Coil she has active
Spider Mines now affects a single enemy, but only lasts for one turn.
Reduces the cooldown of Plasma Shield to 1 turn, but reduces the shield it grants to 25.
Well-Used Panic Button will now trigger when Saya falls below 60 health.
Allies receive 10 Affliction damage when triggering Scratch's Deal skills, but they gain Elemental Essence when doing so.
Heroes affected by Deal: Defeat Your Enemies ignore stuns and counters.
Each round, the first time Scratch falls below 30 HP, his next non-Ultimate Deal skill applies all other non-Ultimate Deal skills.
Scratch's Deal skills no longer have a cooldown, but can only affect each Hero once per round.
Deal: Defeat Your Enemies and Deal: Save Your Friends are now invisible until triggered.
Synthetic Skyblade deals 5 additional base damage, costs an additional Generic, and will consume 2 stacks of Eyes of Vengeance.
Enemies targeted by Heavenly Parry deal 10 reduced damage for their next turn. This effect is invisible.
If Energized Wingstorm consumes 3 or more stacks of Eyes of Vengeance, it will deal an additional 15 Piercing damage to each target the following turn.
Proactivity Protocol now deals 15 normal Damage and heals for 25, but gains an additional 1 turn cooldown.
Divinity Engine lasts an additional turn for each of Sera's dead allies.
Successfully healing Syl's Eagle Minion with Feed lowers the cost of Leyline Nest by [4] until the next time it is used.
To the Skies! now lasts an additional turn.
Enemies stunned by Talon Rake receive 15 damage when the stun ends.
Unbreakable Bond now heals Syl and her Eagle for 10 health after health has been equalized.
Skylance now heals Syl's Eagle minion for 10 health. If her Eagle minion is at maximum life after the heal, she gains Elemental Essence.
Inspiring Thrust now targets all enemies but has an additional 1 turn cooldown.
Protector of the Song now also triggers when Taryn is stunned or countered.
Taryn's Strategic skills cannot be stunned.
Allies affected by Refrain reflect harmful they receive to Taryn.
Refrain will now target a random ally when used on an enemy, or a random enemy when used on an ally.
Allies affected by Laughing Powder also gain the effects of Whimsy.
Enemies under the effect of Barbed Wit now receive 15 Affliction damage when they use a Harmful skill on Titania, and Barbed Wit no longer ends when this occurs.
Thorn Prick no longer deals initial damage, but its affliction damage is doubled.
Titania starts each round with a Summer Courtesan, but her maximum is reduced to 1.
If Prance is triggered by one of Titania's allies, the following turn, the other ally will have their basic abilities' Specific costs changed to Generic
Prisma Maneuver skills mark Prisma Crimson for 3 turns when she uses them or they are used on her. If she is marked by all 3 Prisma Maneuver skills, Crimson Crash deals 40 more damage.
Prisma Whirl now applies Sonata Azure instead of its normal effect.
Saffron Beam now affects all enemies, but using it Shatters Prisma Saffron for 1 turn.
Prisma Lens skills deal 0 damage to their target, increased by 5 for each other Lens skill already used on them this turn.
At the start of each round, a random Prismari Ranger has their maximum HP increased by 20.
Reveal Hidden Truth lowers its targets damage dealt by 10 for 1 turn.
Xyris gains 5 permanent Shield each time he gains Elemental Essence.
If Xyris has Elemental Essence when he uses Enter the Dreamscape, its cooldown is set to 1.
Twisted Nightmares becomes permanent if used on an enemy affected by Enter the Dreamscape.
Dream Reflection minions are created with the countered enemy's current HP.
If Arcadian Duet targets a different enemy than its last target, Zephyrex gains Elemental Essence.
Using Sonic Thrust on an enemy will also use Arcadian Duet on them.

Wind Step now targets an enemy, lowering their non-Affliction damage by 10 for 1 turn. If that enemy uses a new harmful skill during this time, Zephyrex gains Elemental Essence. This effect is invisible.
Perfection now grants Zephyrex immunity to Stuns.
Elegant Sweep is now invisible, and Zephyrex gains the effect of Wind Step while it is active.
While Zev'kir is Channeling Call Tides, he heals 5 HP per turn and ignores stuns.

If Zev'kir has 2 or more stacks of Call Tides, Bubble Prison increases affected enemy skill costs by 1 [65]. If he has 4 or more stacks, they are increased by 1 Energy of the target's Element instead.
If Zev'kir has 2 or more stacks of Call Tides, Riptide deals Piercing damage. If he has 4 or more stacks, it deals Affliction damage instead.
Tidal Wave deals 20 less damage, but its base cost is reduced by 2 Specific energy
While Repulse is not on cooldown, Zev'kir gains 15 Shield that replenishes at the start of his turn.
